blocks.text: Yeh chapter computer networks ke bunyadi concepts (khayalat) sikhata hai aur batata hai ke devices aapas mein kaise baat karte hain. Talaba network architecture (network ka design), ahem components (hisse) aur network ke bunyadi kaam ke baare mein parhte hain. Is mein network models aur layers, khaas taur par OSI model, aur networks ki mukhtalif topologies (jorne ke tareeqe) aur qismein shamil hain. Chapter aam networking devices bhi samjhata hai, jaise NIC, switch, router, modem aur wireless access point.

Talaba zaroori protocols (baat-cheet ke qawaid) aur services se bhi waqif hote hain, jaise TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP aur DNS, aur IP addressing, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting aur NAT ke concepts se bhi. Woh seekhte hain ke ghar ka network kaise set up aur configure (tarteeb) karte hain, wired (taar wale) aur wireless (be-taar) connections samet, aur Wi-Fi security aur encryption (data ko khufia banana) samajhte hain. Ping aur ipconfig jaise network diagnostic tools (masla dhoondne ke auzaar) ka istemal bhi aata hai. Aakhir mein chapter network performance (karkardagi), security ke iqdamat aur asal zindagi ke woh tareeqe batata hai jin se baat-cheet mehfooz aur achhi rehti hai.

Computer network mukhtalif devices ko aapas mein jurne aur baat karne deta hai. Is se maloomat jaldi aur aasani se share hoti hain. Network ke zariye baat-cheet waqt aur mehnat bachati hai. Computer networks gharon, schools, daftaron aur karobar mein istemal hote hain. Aaj ki zindagi rozana ke kaamon ke liye computer networks par bohat munhasir (dependent) hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein Wi-Fi lehron wala wireless router, jo tooti lakeeron (dashed lines) se desktop computer, laptop, monitor, printer, mobile phone, folder, cloud, music aur video ke nishan se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: Computer network mukhtalif devices ko data aur wasail (resources) share karne ke liye jorta hai (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Networks computers, mobile phones, printers aur doosre digital devices ko jor sakte hain (jaise Figure 1.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai). Yeh devices cables ya wireless signals se baat karte hain. Network data, files aur resources (wasail) ko ek device se doosre device tak jane deta hai. Zaroorat ke mutabiq network chhota ya bara ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Networks online parhai aur remote work (ghar se kaam) mein madad dete hain. Karobar apne rozana ke kaamon ke liye networks par bharosa karte hain.

Internet browsing network ke istemal ki aam misaal hai. Mobile phones calls, messages aur apps ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Schools online classes aur learning systems ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Banks online transactions (len-den) aur ATMs ke liye networks istemal karte hain. Social media platforms computer networks ke zariye chalte hain. Smart ghar bhi devices control karne ke liye networks istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Computer network ki tareef karein aur is ke do istemal likhein.
blocks.explanation: Computer network jure hue computers aur devices ka group hai jo data, resources aur services share karte hain. Istemal maslan online banking aur ATM, aur schools mein online classes (aur browsing, calls aur messages, social media, smart ghar).
